text:
emma: Heads up — onboarding token-optimized-7b to prod. Need a quick sanity pass on weights path, tokenizer patch, and batching/caching knobs before we flip traffic. Weights live at s3://redwood-models/token-optimized-7b/2026-03-10/. Note: tokenizer adds a special token <|user|> that triggered an off-by-one in KV-cache in an earlier run.

kai: On it. Pinging @nate for scheduler settings and @lisa for the tokenizer patch. What are our target max_tokens and batching windows for canary?

nate: Current staging serving config (FYI):
```
max_total_tokens: 4096
per_request_max: 1024
continuous_batch:
  window_ms: 100
  max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
```
Planner wants window_ms=50 for lower latency. That change could increase scheduling churn though.

marc: If we drop to window_ms=50 we should also reduce max_tokens_per_batch -> 4096 to avoid OOM on A100 80GB when KV cache is hot. Also enable prefix_cache: true with ttl=10m.

lisa: Tokenizer quirk: adding <|user|> is currently encoded as a separate token which shifts lengths by +1 vs older templates. I pushed a small patch on branch token-fixes-194 (git sha abc123). Workaround in runtime is to set `strip_extra_bos: true` for this model so prompt templates don't double-count.

emma: Concrete asks: 1) verify weights path access from runtime 2) add `strip_extra_bos: true` to model runtime config 3) set continuous_batch.window_ms=50 and max_tokens_per_batch=4096 4) enable prefix_cache: true ttl 600000. Any objections?

deploy-bot: deploy-smoke: staging job queued for token-optimized-7b with runtime overrides. job_id=sb-7765.

kai: I'll run a local smoke with those overrides now, ETA ~20m.

nate: Also adding a CI validation rule in onboarding: ensure tokenizer special tokens don't overlap reserved internal tokens (simple set intersection). Patch will be in next PR.

lisa: I'll add a runtime fallback policy: if tokenizer mismatch detected during request, route 5% traffic to fallback-7b-compat. Will prepare rollout config.

emma: :thumbsup: rollout plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 1h, run regen tests and latency checks between steps. Post any anomalies here.

marc: Also remember to tag the console dashboards: `model:token-optimized-7b` and `release:2026-03-10` so we can trace traces and cost properly.

kai: Local smoke results: no OOM, p50 latency 55ms on small prompts. Logs uploaded: https://redwood.tools/logs/sb-7765 (internal).

emma: Thanks — scheduling canary for 1% in 30m. If nothing flags after 45m proceed to 5%. Will close thread after canary completes.

(attachments: small runtime override snippet pushed to PR)

runtime override example:
```
model: token-optimized-7b
overrides:
  runtime:
    strip_extra_bos: true
    continuous_batch:
      window_ms: 50
      max_tokens_per_batch: 4096
    cache:
      prefix_cache: true
      prefix_cache_ttl_ms: 600000
```
